{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Exclude rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Compute response rate by arm
treatment_response_rate = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = df_clean[df_clean['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_response_rate, control_response_rate"}
